channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2023-6448 — Unitronics Vision PLC and HMI
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Unitronics Vision Series PLCs and HMIs ship with an insecure default password, which if left unchanged, can allow attackers to execute remote commands.

item.title: CVE-2016-20017 — D-Link DSL-2750B Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 73. D-Link DSL-2750B devices contain a command injection vulnerability that allows remote, unauthenticated command injection via the login.cgi cli parameter.

item.title: CVE-2023-41064 — Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS contain a buffer overflow vulnerability in ImageIO when processing a maliciously crafted image, which may lead to code execution. This vulnerability was chained with CVE-2023-41061.

item.title: CVE-2018-14667 — Red Hat JBoss RichFaces Framework
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Red Hat JBoss RichFaces Framework contains an expression language injection vulnerability via the UserResource resource. A remote, unauthenticated attacker could exploit this vulnerability to execute malicious code using a chain of Java serialized objects via org.ajax4jsf.resource.UserResource$UriData.

item.title: CVE-2023-26359 — Adobe ColdFusion
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Adobe ColdFusion contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could result in code execution in the context of the current user.

item.title: CVE-2024-21410 — Microsoft Exchange Server
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2023-49897 — FXC AE1021, AE1021PE
item.description: Threat Signal 68. FXC AE1021 and AE1021PE contain an OS command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to execute commands via a network.

item.title: CVE-2023-5217 — Google Chromium libvpx
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Google Chromium libvpx contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in vp8 encoding that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could impact web browsers using libvpx, including but not limited to Google Chrome.

item.title: CVE-2023-6345 — Google Chromium Skia
item.description: Threat Signal 62. Google Chromium Skia contains an integer overflow vulnerability that allows a remote attacker, who has compromised the renderer process, to potentially perform a sandbox escape via a malicious file. This vulnerability affects Google Chrome and ChromeOS, Android, Flutter, and possibly other products.

item.title: CVE-2023-20269 — Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance and Firepower Threat Defense
item.description: Threat Signal 73. Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance and Firepower Threat Defense contain an unauthorized access vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to conduct a brute force attack in an attempt to identify valid username and password combinations or establish a clientless SSL VPN session with an unauthorized user.

item.title: CVE-2023-47565 — QNAP VioStor NVR
item.description: Threat Signal 73. QNAP VioStar NVR contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to execute commands via a network.

item.title: CVE-2023-4762 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Google Chromium V8 contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute code via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2024-23222 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, and Safari WebKit contain a type confusion vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

item.title: CVE-2023-28434 — MinIO MinIO
item.description: Threat Signal 60. MinIO contains a security feature bypass vulnerability that allows an attacker to use crafted requests to bypass metadata bucket name checking and put an object into any bucket while processing `PostPolicyBucket` to conduct privilege escalation. To carry out this attack, the attacker requires credentials with `arn:aws:s3:::*` permission, as well as enabled Console API access.

item.title: CVE-2023-41993 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and Safari WebKit contain an unspecified vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

item.title: CVE-2023-42917 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and Safari WebKit contain a memory corruption vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

item.title: CVE-2018-15133 — Laravel Laravel Framework
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Laravel Framework contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability, allowing for remote command execution. This vulnerability may only be exploited if a malicious user has accessed the application encryption key (APP_KEY environment variable).

item.title: CVE-2023-21608 — Adobe Acrobat and Reader
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Adobe Acrobat and Reader contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows for code execution in the context of the current user.

item.title: CVE-2023-29360 — Microsoft Streaming Service
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Microsoft Streaming Service contains an untrusted pointer dereference vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation, enabling a local attacker to gain SYSTEM privileges.

item.title: CVE-2023-4911 — GNU GNU C Library
item.description: Threat Signal 72. GNU C Library's dynamic loader ld.so contains a buffer overflow vulnerability when processing the GLIBC_TUNABLES environment variable, allowing a local attacker to execute code with elevated privileges.

item.title: CVE-2023-29552 — IETF Service Location Protocol (SLP)
item.description: Threat Signal 68. The Service Location Protocol (SLP) contains a denial-of-service (DoS) vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to register services and use spoofed UDP traffic to conduct a denial-of-service (DoS) attack with a significant amplification factor.

item.title: CVE-2024-0519 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains an out-of-bounds memory access vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2023-6548 — Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain a code injection vulnerability that allows for authenticated remote code execution on the management interface with access to NSIP, CLIP, or SNIP.

item.title: CVE-2023-7024 — Google Chromium WebRTC
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Google Chromium WebRTC, an open-source project providing web browsers with real-time communication, contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could impact web browsers using WebRTC, including but not limited to Google Chrome.

item.title: CVE-2023-46748 — F5 BIG-IP Configuration Utility
item.description: Threat Signal 59. F5 BIG-IP Configuration utility contains an SQL injection vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker with network access through the BIG-IP management port and/or self IP addresses to execute system commands. This vulnerability can be used in conjunction with CVE-2023-46747.

item.title: CVE-2017-6884 — Zyxel EMG2926 Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Zyxel EMG2926 routers contain a command injection vulnerability located in the diagnostic tools, specifically the nslookup function. A malicious user may exploit numerous vectors to execute malicious commands on the router, such as the ping_ip parameter to the expert/maintenance/diagnostic/nslookup URI.

item.title: CVE-2023-49103 — ownCloud ownCloud graphapi
item.description: Threat Signal 71. ownCloud graphapi contains an information disclosure vulnerability that can reveal sensitive data stored in phpinfo() via GetPhpInfo.php, including administrative credentials.

item.title: CVE-2023-36802 — Microsoft Streaming Service Proxy
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Microsoft Streaming Service Proxy contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2023-6549 — Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows for a denial-of-service when configured as a Gateway (VPN virtual server, ICA Proxy, CVPN, RDP Proxy) or AAA virtual server.

item.title: CVE-2023-7101 — Spreadsheet::ParseExcel Spreadsheet::ParseExcel
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Spreadsheet::ParseExcel contains a remote code execution vulnerability due to passing unvalidated input from a file into a string-type “eval”. Specifically, the issue stems from the evaluation of Number format strings within the Excel parsing logic.

item.title: CVE-2024-21351 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Microsoft Windows SmartScreen contains a security feature bypass vulnerability that allows an attacker to bypass the SmartScreen user experience and inject code to potentially gain code execution, which could lead to some data exposure, lack of system availability, or both.

item.title: CVE-2023-35081 — Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM)
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) contains a path traversal vulnerability that enables an authenticated administrator to perform malicious file writes to the EPMM server. This vulnerability can be used in conjunction with CVE-2023-35078 to bypass authentication and ACLs restrictions (if applicable).

item.title: CVE-2023-36025 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Microsoft Windows SmartScreen contains a security feature bypass vulnerability that could allow an attacker to bypass Windows Defender SmartScreen checks and their associated prompts.

item.title: CVE-2019-7256 — Nice Linear eMerge E3-Series
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Nice Linear eMerge E3-Series contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows an attacker to conduct remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2023-33246 — Apache RocketMQ
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Several components of Apache RocketMQ, including NameServer, Broker, and Controller, are exposed to the extranet and lack permission verification. An attacker can exploit this vulnerability by using the update configuration function to execute commands as the system users that RocketMQ is running as or achieve the same effect by forging the RocketMQ protocol content.

item.title: CVE-2023-24489 — Citrix Content Collaboration
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Citrix Content Collaboration contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to remotely compromise customer-managed ShareFile storage zones controllers.

item.title: CVE-2017-18368 — Zyxel P660HN-T1A Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Zyxel P660HN-T1A routers contain a command injection vulnerability in the Remote System Log forwarding function, which is accessible by an unauthenticated user and exploited via the remote_host parameter of the ViewLog.asp page.

item.title: CVE-2023-27524 — Apache Superset
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Apache Superset contains an insecure default initialization of a resource vulnerability that allows an attacker to authenticate and access unauthorized resources on installations that have not altered the default configured SECRET_KEY according to installation instructions.

item.title: CVE-2020-2551 — Oracle Fusion Middleware
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Oracle Fusion Middleware contains an unspecified vulnerability in the WLS Core Components that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access via IIOP to compromise the WebLogic Server.

item.title: CVE-2023-36845 — Juniper Junos OS
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Juniper Junos OS on EX Series and SRX Series contains a PHP external variable modification vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, network-based attacker to control an important environment variable. Using a crafted request, which sets the variable PHPRC, an attacker is able to modify the PHP execution environment allowing the injection und execution of code.

item.title: CVE-2023-37580 — Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS)
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability impacting the confidentiality and integrity of data.

item.title: CVE-2023-36036 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Microsoft Windows Cloud Files Mini Filter Driver contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that could allow an attacker to gain SYSTEM privileges.

item.title: CVE-2022-22265 — Samsung Mobile Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 56. Samsung devices with selected Exynos chipsets contain a use-after-free vulnerability that allows malicious memory write and code execution.

item.title: CVE-2023-42824 — Apple iOS and iPadOS
item.description: Threat Signal 56. Apple iOS and iPadOS contain an unspecified vulnerability that allows for local privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2023-33107 — Qualcomm Multiple Chipsets
item.description: Threat Signal 56. Multiple Qualcomm chipsets contain an integer overflow vulnerability due to memory corruption in Graphics Linux while assigning shared virtual memory region during IOCTL call.

item.title: CVE-2023-33106 — Qualcomm Multiple Chipsets
item.description: Threat Signal 56. Multiple Qualcomm chipsets contain a use of out-of-range pointer offset vulnerability due to memory corruption in Graphics while submitting a large list of sync points in an AUX command to the IOCTL_KGSL_GPU_AUX_COMMAND.

item.title: CVE-2023-33063 — Qualcomm Multiple Chipsets
item.description: Threat Signal 56. Multiple Qualcomm chipsets contain a use-after-free vulnerability due to memory corruption in DSP Services during a remote call from HLOS to DSP.

item.title: CVE-2022-22071 — Qualcomm Multiple Chipsets
item.description: Threat Signal 56. Multiple Qualcomm chipsets contain a use-after-free vulnerability when process shell memory is freed using IOCTL munmap call and process initialization is in progress.

item.title: CVE-2023-41990 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 56. Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, and watchOS contain an unspecified vulnerability that allows for code execution when processing a font file.

item.title: CVE-2023-43770 — Roundcube Webmail
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Roundcube Webmail contains a persistent cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability that can lead to information disclosure via malicious link references in plain/text messages.
